admission.justification: Focused numeric cases guard false add/remove totals from treating an unreadable side as empty or counting a trailing terminator as code. Reassessed at the L201 fifth freeze (head d59c3493): the guarded_by_test criterion is dropped because the proofs that named it were removed with the tests they cited, which are gone at the candidate; the criteria kept are the ones the tree still satisfies.

applicability: Location added/removed line accounting in the review change-set model and its row/card count presentation.
conditions: Use the actual line diff of both complete excerpts for+a and−r.
An absent file side is known empty, so additions/removals count every supplied line.
A final excerpt newline is a terminator, not one extra empty line.
Unknown, unreadable, unresolved or cut text does not count as empty; preserve the mapped span fallback.
The visible sign stays in the count text; mint additions and alarm-red removals follow the approved rendering.
exclusions: Substituting raw span length for known added/removed counts.
Confusing invariant code-change counts with all changed files.
